why: Enacting statute; Chapter IV articles 15-18 are the authentication capability itself, with ANID exclusive competence, the consent duty and the positive/negative response rule. File shared with a sibling slice.
Article 8 is the from-birth rule: under-fives enrolled on demographic data plus a parent or guardian NIU, biometrics deferred to age five. Same file as the authentication baseline.
First national catch-up campaign, 12-27 November 2025: 5,000 CM2 pupils across 25 communes, jugements suppletifs then transcription. Completed step with figures.
Distinct second campaign launched 31 July 2026: 6,461 more children, 11,461 cumulative across both editions.
ANID own dated statement of the standing position: the identity file is not linked to the civil registry to extract deaths, and identity providers still need networking to identity users.
Naissance Keva links maternity units to etat civil, live since February 2026 in Vo, with a certification threshold of 90 per cent of births documented within eight days.
Online civil-registry copy requests launched 19 December 2025 in five pilot communes. Distinct event; file already staged by a sibling slice, selection repointed at it.
Gazette text of Decret 2020-093/PR constituting ANID as the standing operator, with financial autonomy, dual technical oversight, board-adopted budget and staff rules.
Signed USD 20 million WURI additional financing on 16 July 2026, extending funding of the register past the 30 July 2026 closing date. A completed signature, not an intention.
Fifty new enrolment centres opened at Atakpame, extending ANID own operating footprint into the Plateaux after Savanes, Grand Lome and Maritime.

ANID own account of what was put under test - MOSIP deployment, ABIS deduplication, QR conformity, online/offline operation, kit autonomy - plus backup kit, generators and daily incident reports. The only robustness document of Togolese origin found.
Dated closure of Agoe-Nyive enrolment on 16 September 2025 with card collection to 25 September, and the register-integrity rule that double enrolment is forbidden even where a card has not arrived.
Western Plateaux expansion from 7 May 2026, carrying the coverage figure the indicator turns on: more than six million NIU by end-2025 on official figures.
Gazette text of Decret 2024-071/PR compelling electronic-communications operators to record the ANID-issued NIU for nationals and residents - the clearest third-party consumption mandate in force.
Supervisor dated finding of non-appropriation of the project of interconnectivity of platforms and databases, with EMIS at prototype and HRMIS at test phase. Settles the standing state.
National results platform in production for Bac1 2026, and each establishment supplied its own pupils results directly rather than waiting to compute them.

Togo own account to the continental CRVS experts meeting of an operating CRVS-education integration: 125,356 pupil identities since 2024, an annual joint dashboard, plus the stated coordination and legal-framework gaps.

The SNIS operating manual is the exchange system itself - the facility to district to region to DHIS2 reporting chain. Already staged by a sibling slice; selection repointed at that file rather than restaged.
SIAMU-INAM built to CNSS standards with its data hosted in the CNSS data centre - the most operational INAM/CNSS interoperability step in window. Already staged by a sibling slice.
Deployed cross-institution exchange: ERA-5 ingestion into the national HMIS and malaria repository, and a MoH-ANAMET data-sharing memorandum feeding a monthly national bulletin.

Gazette text creating the RSPM: held electronically, keyed on the NIU and a household NIM, managed by ANID, with an explicit duty to ensure interconnection with existing and future administrative databases.
National cash-transfer launch of 18 December 2025 for over 700,000 people, with INSEED and ANADEB doing joint targeting and mobile money doing payment.
INAM social-insurance system built on CNSS standards and hosted in the CNSS data centre - distinct from the transfers event. Already staged by a sibling slice.

Gazette text of Arrete 007/MENTD/CAB setting the whole access-and-sharing procedure: request, ANID supply, mandatory convention, IPDCP authorisation, authenticated and logged access, quarterly reporting. The nearest thing Togo has to a documented data-exchange protocol.
Civil-registry service brought onto the national service-public gateway on 19 December 2025 - the clearest in-window consumption of the shared service layer. Already staged by a sibling slice.
